definition.en: How living things develop and reproduce across generations. A life-cycle ring connects parents with their offspring.
definition.zh: 生物发育、繁殖，并一代接一代的过程。生命周期的环形图把亲代和后代连起来。

definition.en: A structure in which a young animal can develop after fertilisation, under suitable conditions. Chicken eggs have shells; the frog eggs shown here have jelly coats.
definition.zh: 动物幼体可以在其中发育的结构，需要先受精并有适宜条件。鸡卵有壳；这里的蛙卵有胶质包被。

definition.en: A frog larva that swims with a tail. Its body looks very different from an adult frog. It is not a fish.
definition.zh: 靠尾巴游泳的青蛙幼体，外形与成蛙差别很大。它不是鱼。

definition.en: A young frog with a frog-shaped body and limbs. A short tail may remain while the body absorbs it.
definition.zh: 已经有蛙形身体和四肢的幼小青蛙。身体吸收尾巴时，还可能留着一段短尾。

definition.en: A mature animal that has reached the stage when it can reproduce. The adult chicken shown here is a hen.
definition.zh: 已经成熟、能够繁殖的动物。这里展示的成鸡是一只母鸡。

definition.en: A young chicken that grows into an adult. Its life cycle has no pupa stage.
definition.zh: 幼小的鸡，会继续长成成鸡，发育过程没有蛹期。

definition.en: A young animal developing before it hatches. In a chicken egg, it is separate from the yolk.
definition.zh: 孵出前正在发育的动物幼体。在鸡卵内，胚胎与卵黄是不同结构。

definition.en: The part of an egg that supplies food for the developing embryo. The yolk itself is not a chick.
definition.zh: 卵内给发育中的胚胎提供营养的部分。卵黄本身不是雏鸡。

definition.en: A young animal coming out of its egg. It has already begun developing inside the egg.
definition.zh: 动物幼体从卵中出来。在这以前，它已经在卵内开始发育。

definition.en: The joining of male and female reproductive cells. A chicken egg must be fertilised and have suitable incubation conditions for a chick to develop.
definition.zh: 雄性与雌性生殖细胞结合。鸡卵先受精，再有适宜的孵化条件，才可能发育出雏鸡。

definition.en: Producing offspring: the next generation. The arrow from an adult to eggs shows this process.
definition.zh: 产生后代，也就是下一代。成体通向卵的箭头表示这个过程。

definition.en: A large change in body form as a young animal develops towards adulthood. A frog undergoes metamorphosis without a pupa stage.
definition.zh: 幼体发育、逐渐成为成体时，身体形态发生明显变化的过程。青蛙的变态发育没有蛹期。

definition.en: The stage between larva and adult in a mosquito's life cycle. Frogs and chickens have no pupa stage.
definition.zh: 蚊子的生命周期中，幼虫与成虫之间的阶段。青蛙和鸡没有蛹期。

definition.en: A young plant that has grown from a seed. It can continue growing into an adult plant.
definition.zh: 由种子长出的幼小植物，可以继续长成成株。
